_comment: SYNTHETIC, and not a capture. Every span here was generated from the spring-petclinic pack's OWN endpoint->tables answers, one span tree per route: a server span carrying http.route and http.request.method, and under it one JDBC span per table that pack says the route reaches. A route the pack answers no table for gets a server span with nothing under it, which is the honest record of a request that ran no SQL. WHAT IT IS FOR: the shape of a run that exercised every one of the 17 routes, which test/fixtures/otel/petclinic-agent.log (a real agent capture of 10 of them) cannot show. WHAT IT IS NOT: evidence about this engine. Its labels came from the engine, so a golden corpus built from it passes by construction; the real capture is the one that can disagree, and it does. It carries no host, no concrete URL, no process or thread attribute and no bound parameter, which is the rule the real capture is kept under. REGENERATED in RM54, from the answers the JPA lane gives once it follows the eager fetch plan and once a @ModelAttribute method is reachable from the handlers Spring runs it for: the routes that used to answer nothing now answer the tables an eager Owner or Vet loads.
